facts.summary: Multi-dose cohorts confounded by bad drug lot, asthma study halted, restructuring · Phase 1b/2a · briquilimab in chronic spontaneous urticaria · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Results from the 240mg Q8W and the 240mg followed by 180mg Q8W cohorts appear to be confounded by issues with one drug product lot
evidence.safety: Briquilimab continued to be well tolerated in the BEACON study, as well as the open label extension, with no dose limiting toxicities observed.
evidence.program_discontinued: the Company is halting the study and pausing development in asthma. In addition, the Company is halting development in SCID
